stories.title: Granizo no oeste do Rio Grande do Sul afeta 9.500 pessoas e danifica 2.200 casas

en.title: Hail in western Rio Grande do Sul affects 9,500 people and damages 2,200 houses
en.summary: A hailstorm struck western Rio Grande do Sul over the weekend, affecting more than 9,500 people and damaging approximately 2,200 houses. According to state civil defense authorities, there was one injured person and ten people left homeless, with no deaths reported.

stories.title: Extrema direita ganha espaço no Senado da França com recorde de cadeiras da história de sigla de Le Pen e aliados

en.title: Far-right gains ground in French Senate with record number of seats for Le Pen's party and allies
en.summary: France's far-right National Rally party and its allies won a historic record of 14 seats in the French Senate in elections held Sunday. The party quadrupled its representation ahead of presidential elections scheduled for next year.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro confirma ida a debate da Globo e chama Lula para confronto

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro confirms attendance at Globo debate and challenges Lula for confrontation
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed his participation in a television debate and challenged President Lula to participate in the confrontation.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que vai ao debate da Globo e desafia Lula a participar do embate antes do 1º turno; vídeo

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro says he will attend Globo debate and challenges Lula to participate in clash before first round; video
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro announced his participation in the Globo debate scheduled for next Thursday and challenged President Lula to attend and face him. The confirmation was made during a campaign caravan in Goiânia.

stories.title: Campanha de Flávio acusa Dino de usurpar função do TSE após liberar publicações sobre Nossa Senhora

en.title: Flávio's campaign accuses Dino of usurping TSE function after allowing posts about Nossa Senhora
en.summary: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign criticized a Supreme Court minister's decision to allow social media posts about a law granting Nossa Senhora Aparecida the title of Brazil's patroness.

stories.title: Campanha de Flávio se diz ‘perplexa’ com decisão que liberou posts sobre falso ataque à padroeira

en.title: Flávio's campaign says it is 'perplexed' with decision allowing posts about false attack on patroness
en.summary: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign expressed confusion regarding a judicial decision that permitted posts concerning a false attack on Nossa Senhora Aparecida.

stories.title: Caiado critica ‘enfrentamento religioso’ após notícia falsa citando Flávio Bolsonaro e Nossa Senhora

en.title: Caiado criticizes 'religious confrontation' after false news mentioning Flávio Bolsonaro and Nossa Senhora
en.summary: A political figure criticized what he described as religious confrontation following misinformation that linked Flávio Bolsonaro to Nossa Senhora Aparecida.

stories.title: Dino derruba decisão de Mendonça e libera post sobre Nossa Senhora

en.title: Dino overturns Mendonça's decision and allows post about Nossa Senhora
en.summary: Supreme Court minister Flávio Dino reversed another judge's decision to remove a social media post about Nossa Senhora Aparecida by a comedian that contained political commentary.

stories.title: Em Aracaju, Flávio Bolsonaro diz que Lula tem dois filhos: 'Lulinha e o tigrinho'

en.title: In Aracaju, Flávio Bolsonaro says Lula has two children: 'Lulinha and the tigrinho'
en.summary: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro held a campaign rally in Aracaju with a modest turnout, where he made critical remarks about President Lula.

stories.title: Dino derruba decisão de Mendonça que removeu posts sobre falso apoio de Flávio a ‘tirar padroeira’

en.title: Dino overturns Mendonça's decision that removed posts about false support from Flávio to 'remove patron saint'
en.summary: Justice Minister Dino reversed a previous ruling that had removed social media posts regarding a political support matter involving a religious figure.

stories.title: Ato da esquerda em SP adota discurso religioso após disputa sobre Nossa Senhora Aparecida

en.title: Left-wing rally in São Paulo adopts religious discourse after dispute over Nossa Senhora Aparecida
en.summary: Left-wing candidates in São Paulo held events with religious elements, including a mass and a women's rights gathering, during a week when religion became prominent in the campaign.

stories.title: Dino anula decisão do TSE e libera publicação sobre Nossa Senhora que causou dano a Flávio Bolsonaro

en.title: Dino annuls TSE decision and authorizes publication about Nossa Senhora that caused damage to Flávio Bolsonaro
en.summary: Justice Minister Flávio Dino of the Supreme Court reversed a prior decision and permitted social media publications regarding the law that designates Nossa Senhora Aparecida as the patron saint of Brazil.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro confirma ida ao debate da Globo mesmo que Lula não compareça

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro confirms attendance at Globo debate even if Lula does not attend
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro stated he will participate in a Globo presidential debate on Thursday despite indicating his main rival Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva may not attend the event.

stories.title: ‘Nunca imaginei jogar no Brasil’, diz dono do Dallas Cowboys da NFL

en.title: 'Never imagined playing in Brazil', says owner of Dallas Cowboys in the NFL
en.summary: Dallas Cowboys owner Jerry Jones expressed surprise at hosting an NFL game in Brazil at the Maracanã Stadium, noting the team is currently valued at 17 billion dollars.

stories.title: Bets articulam reação na Justiça com ação coletiva

en.title: Betting companies organize legal response with collective action
en.summary: Digital betting companies are preparing a collective legal challenge to a provisional measure published Friday, with discussions underway about filing an action with the Supreme Federal Court.

stories.title: Caiado e Renan Santos criticam veto de Lula às bets e veem manobra eleitoral

en.title: Caiado and Renan Santos criticize Lula's ban on betting and see electoral maneuver
en.summary: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado criticized President Lula's decision to prohibit betting companies in Brazil, calling it opportunistic while stating he would impose restrictions rather than a complete ban if elected.

stories.title: Do ouro ao petróleo: a inteligência artificial será a próxima âncora do dólar?

en.title: From gold to oil: will artificial intelligence be the next anchor of the dollar?
en.summary: Artificial intelligence could provide a new foundation for the dollar's value, similar to gold and oil in previous eras. The competition for data centers, semiconductors, energy, and payment systems is increasing technology's economic importance and raising questions about future links between the US currency and the global economy.
